description: Local readings and the explicit query keep tested rule tags through recognition.
grammar:
%rule text r<T> m :: ∅
%rule r q A :: T
%rule q ε
%conditions ¬$.starts-input ∨ $.starts-input
%rule m M
%check same #·m
%conditions $.preceding-element.local-readings, $.preceding-element.onward.parse(r<T> …),
  $.preceding-element.local-readings.tags = $.preceding-element.onward.parse(r<T> …).tags,
  $.preceding-element.local-readings.tags = T
%warning "same"
